<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Pigeon</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Pigeon means dated gambling slang for a player viewed as an easy target. This is dated and insulting slang, so it should be labelled clearly rather than used as ordinary teaching language.</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-category"><strong>Glossary category:</strong> <a href="/learn/glossary/?category=language%2C%20rules%2C%20and%20culture#term-pigeon">Language, Rules, and Culture</a></p>
<p class="bms-glossary-usage-note"><strong>Usage note:</strong> Dated and derogatory player slang; label clearly if retained.</p>
